# UTC schedule month editor

Public interface: moveUTCMonth in src/schedule-month.cjs.

moveUTCMonth(date, month, day?) must expose Date.setUTCMonth semantics: mutate the supplied Date in UTC and return the new numeric timestamp. month is zero-based. An omitted day, an explicitly supplied undefined day, and an out-of-range month must follow the page exactly. Preserve the time of day for valid results. Explain why defaulting the day to 1 loses information.

Documentation: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date/setUTCMonth

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Use Node built-ins only. Keep the public interface and the original tests/ assertions. Install no dependencies. Runtime code and checks must work offline and create no project artifacts; put any temporary files in the system temporary directory.
